main_body: Wide industrial building: a large corrugated blue-grey metal roof slope (rows ~28-88) with a raised skylight/vent ridge, sitting over a brick wall storey with arched lit windows, a riveted double door and copper pipes (rows ~90-126).
top_band: In the middle column: dark cap line at rows ~28-29, lighter ridge/vent band at rows ~29-35, then the corrugated roof slope in mid to dark blue-grey down to row ~88. The orange eave trim follows at rows ~89-92.
evidence: The roof is a large sloped top surface, much like the tiled roofs on the Beodeul house references. It is clearly separated from the wall by a distinct orange eave line at rows ~89-92, with a dark brick wall beneath that reads as set back. The arched windows have sills and dark frames, and the door is inset with a frame and rivets. A raised skylight ridge adds a second top surface. No receding side faces are drawn.

style.evidence: The roof carries vertical corrugation, tonal banding, rust speckle and glass panes with diagonal glints. The wall has brick courses with per-brick variation, and the windows are glowing with lit mullions. The door has rivets and panel relief. Outlines are mostly dark tinted tones of the adjacent material (blue-grey beside metal, dark brown beside brick), not uniform black. Detail density per tile matches or exceeds the Beodeul house references, and there are no large flat fills.
